# mapx Docs

> Maps and location APIs for Austria from official open data (CC BY 4.0). No key, open CORS. Every page is also available as Markdown (append .md to the path, for example /guides/maps.md). German pages live under /de/.

## Get started
- [What is mapx](https://docs.mapx.at/start/what-is-mapx/)
- [Access and limits](https://docs.mapx.at/start/access-and-limits/): no key, rate-limit zones, attribution
- [First map in 5 minutes](https://docs.mapx.at/start/first-map/)
- [First search](https://docs.mapx.at/start/first-search/)
- [First route](https://docs.mapx.at/start/first-route/)
- [Glossary](https://docs.mapx.at/start/glossary/), [FAQ](https://docs.mapx.at/start/faq/)

## Reference
- [API overview](https://docs.mapx.at/api/): generated from https://api.mapx.at/v1/openapi.json
- APIs: [Tiles](https://docs.mapx.at/api/tiles/), [Styles](https://docs.mapx.at/api/styles/), [Geocoding](https://docs.mapx.at/api/geocoding/), [Search Box](https://docs.mapx.at/api/search-box/), [Address](https://docs.mapx.at/api/address/), [Directions](https://docs.mapx.at/api/directions/), [Optimization](https://docs.mapx.at/api/optimization/), [Transit](https://docs.mapx.at/api/transit/), [Static Images](https://docs.mapx.at/api/static-images/), [Tilequery and Parcel](https://docs.mapx.at/api/tilequery/), [Elevation](https://docs.mapx.at/api/elevation/), [Weather](https://docs.mapx.at/api/weather/), [Traffic](https://docs.mapx.at/api/traffic/)
- [Tilesets](https://docs.mapx.at/tilesets/), [Style specification](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/style-spec/), [Terrain-RGB](https://docs.mapx.at/reference/terrain-rgb/)

## Key facts
- Base URL https://api.mapx.at/v1/, tiles https://tiles.mapx.at/v1/tiles/{tileset}/{z}/{x}/{y}.{ext}. Coordinates are lon,lat.
- Styles: streets, streets-dawn, streets-dusk, streets-night, satellite, satellite-streets, outdoors. Tilesets: streets, cadastre, contours, terrain-rgb, dsm, orthophoto, orthophoto-flight-blocks.
- Routing profiles: driving, driving-traffic, driving-truck, cycling, walking.
- Terrain-RGB: height_m = -10000 + (R*65536 + G*256 + B)*0.1.
- Errors are application/problem+json with a stable code. Rate limits per zone in the RateLimit-Policy header.
